input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: write_correlated_logs.py
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_LOGS_API_URL = os.getenv("OPENAI_LOGS_API_URL", "https://api.openai.com/v1")
+
+
+def _now_iso() -> str:
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+
+def _build_event(level: str, message: str, correlation_id: str, request_id: str) -> dict:
+    return {
+        "provider": "openai",
+        "level": level,
+        "message": message,
+        "correlation_id": correlation_id,
+        "request_id": request_id,
+        "timestamp": _now_iso(),
+    }
+
+
+def write_correlated_logs(message: str) -> int:
+    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    correlation_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
+    request_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
+
+    session = requests.Session()
+    session.headers.update(
+        {
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        }
+    )
+
+    events = [
+        _build_event("info", f"starting: {message}", correlation_id, request_id),
+        _build_event("info", f"processing: {message}", correlation_id, request_id),
+        _build_event("info", f"finished: {message}", correlation_id, request_id),
+    ]
+
+    for event in events:
+        payload = {"input": json.dumps(event), "model": "gpt-5.4-mini"}
+        response = session.post(f"{OPENAI_LOGS_API_URL}/responses", json=payload, timeout=30)
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        time.sleep(0.1)
+
+    return 0
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    message = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "request"
+    return write_correlated_logs(message)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: write_structured_log.py
+import json
+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+from google.cloud import logging as cloud_logging
+
+
+def write_structured_log() -> None:
+    client = cloud_logging.Client()
+    logger = client.logger("structured-json-log")
+    payload = {
+        "event": "structured_log_write",
+        "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+        "service": "google_cloud_logging",
+        "severity": "INFO",
+        "details": {
+            "message": os.getenv("LOG_MESSAGE", "structured log event"),
+            "request_id": os.getenv("REQUEST_ID", "unknown"),
+        },
+    }
+    logger.log_struct(payload, severity="INFO")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    write_structured_log()
*** End Patch
